hero.title: We turn your dreams into reality.
hero.subtitle: We carry out complete apartment and house renovations in the Karlovy Vary region. From initial design to final cleanup – reliably, with quality, and on time.

services.title: From minor adjustments to complete transformation

cores.title: Bathroom core renovations
cores.text: We modernize and rebuild prefab and masonry bathroom cores. Increase the comfort and value of your apartment.

apartments.title: Complete apartment renovations
apartments.text: We handle everything from demolition work through new installations to final surfaces and kitchen assembly.

houses.title: House renovations
houses.text: We carry out interior and exterior house renovations, including insulation, facades, and layout modifications.

crafts.title: Craft services
crafts.text: We also offer individual masonry, tiling, flooring, plumbing, and electrical work.

why.title: Your renovation without stress or compromise

one.title: One company, all trades
one.text: No need to find and coordinate various trades. We take care of complete project management, saving you time and worries.

two.title: We meet deadlines and budgets
two.text: At the beginning, we set a fixed budget and work schedule that is binding for us. No unpleasant surprises with us.

three.title: Focus on quality and detail
three.text: We use certified materials and proven methods. We take pride in precise execution of every detail, because it matters.

four.title: Personal approach and consultation
four.text: We are your partner throughout the entire project. We listen to your wishes and are happy to advise you on material selection and technical solutions.

process.title: Your path to a new home in 5 steps

step1.title: Contact and initial consultation
step1.text: Call us or write to us. We will discuss your ideas and arrange a personal meeting at the project site. All free of charge.

step2.title: Site survey and price quote
step2.text: We perform precise measurements, discuss materials, and within a week prepare a detailed and transparent price quote.

step3.title: Contract and schedule
step3.text: After approval of the quote, we sign a work contract containing a fixed budget, scope of work, and binding schedule.

step4.title: Renovation execution
step4.text: Our team gets to work. During construction, we communicate with you regularly and conduct inspection days.

step5.title: Handover and warranty
step5.text: After completion and final cleanup, we formally hand over the project. We naturally provide a full warranty on our work.

references.title: Hundreds of satisfied customers in the region

client1.name: The Novak Family
client1.text: PJ-Rekonstrukce completely renovated our apartment. I appreciate Mr. Jaros's excellent communication and adherence to both price and schedule. Everything went absolutely smoothly.

client2.name: Petr S.
client2.text: I needed to quickly renovate an apartment after tenants before the next rental. They managed everything in record time and with excellent quality. I can only recommend.
